Old Town Roll

Alexandria, VA · Old Town · Road

No-drop

Old Town Roll is a road group ride in Alexandria, VA. It rolls every Saturday at 8:30 am from Conte's Bike Shop Alexandria. About 22 miles, 14-16 mph (B pace). No-drop.

For visitors

Last year's calendar series ended Nov 1, 2025, so the ride may pause for winter.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 8:30 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 14-16 mph: steady — you'll breathe hard on the hills. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Old Town Roll group ride

A 22-mile B-pace road ride (14-16 mph) from the Conte's shop on King Street. The ride is no-drop and meant to give your legs a burn while catching up with friends.
